description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2017 World Championships, built around Gardevoir-GX: its Secret Spring Ability attaches extra Fairy Energy, and its Infinite Force attack turns that Energy into damage. Rare Candy and Diancie speed up evolving, Octillery keeps the hand full and Tapu Lele-GX finds the Supporter needed. The 2017 World Championships were held at the Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, California, from 18 to 20 August 2017.

Pokémon sold it as a 2017 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
